full_judgment:
M.H. Rahman, J.: These two appeals, at the instance of the pre-empties, have arisen out of two miscellaneous cases tinder section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, Miscellaneous Cases Nos. 173 of 1978 and 84 of 1981 of the Third Court of Munsif, Tangail. The cases were heard and disposed of together in the courts below. 

 6. The appellants contend that provisions of section 91 of the Evidence Act are no bar for challenging the character of the documents which were, in fact, given to the heirs of the murdered Abdul Majid Mondal, and that the sale deeds ought to have been construed as deeds of exchange, and that they were not pre-empt able under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act.
